arguments.prompt:
Create one native pixel-art game animation SOURCE ATLAS of Waffle Ryebread. FIXED INCARNATION: Tail Concerto (1998), Police Robo patrol. APPEARANCE: Waffle is a small yellow-tan Caninu dog with pointed ears, orange-blond fringe, BLUE peaked police cap, pale blue uniform shirt with red tie, dark gray trousers, white gloves and dark boots. He remains visibly seated inside the COMPLETE Police Robo: cream-gray/taupe round metal torso, segmented BROWN articulated long arms, blue-gray short legs, metal claw hands, red cockpit seat and TWO tall back exhaust pipes. The short central front nozzle is the bubble blaster. Both pilot and complete robot remain in every pose.. EQUIPMENT AND ROLE: actual cream-gray Police Robo with brown segmented grab arms and front bubble blaster. SOURCE ACTION: Bulle de capture du Police Robo. The USA manual printedpages4 and6 depicts the Police Robo’s cream-gray body, brown segmented arms, blue-gray legs, red seat and twin back pipes. Printedpage23 depicts Waffle’s blue uniform and red tie. The bubble arrests nonlethally; controls include grab, throw and bubble blaster.

Detailed clean16-bit pixel art. Consistent three-quarter side view FACING RIGHT. EXACTLY48 COMPLETE INDEPENDENTLY DRAWN FIGURES, EIGHT COLUMNS and SIX ROWS (8x6). Every consecutive FOUR figures is a four-pose sequence. Every full head, native limbs, wings, tail and complete tool must remain inside its own cell. Draw slightly smaller bodies and GENEROUS TRANSPARENT GUTTERS with a32px outer margin. No overlapping figures, touching silhouettes, labels, text, numbers, grid, scenery, ground, shadows or watermark. Transparent background.

ROW1 columns1-4 INTRO: four different approaching/ready postures. Columns5-8 OUTRO: lower tools/hands, turn, depart, settle.
ROW2 columns1-4 ROUND VICTORY: four brief source-personality acknowledgments. Columns5-8 ROUND LOSS: four different disappointed/breathing/steady postures, completely unharmed.
ROW3 columns1-4 FINISHING PRESENTATION: Waffle stays visibly inside his complete Police Robo: ready, aim the actual bubble nozzle, release ONE small blue transparent capture bubble close to the nozzle in THIRD pose, recover. Bubble is a NONLETHAL capture tool, never a damaging ray. No kitten or captured victim is drawn. Columns5-8 MATCH VICTORY: four distinct celebrations DIFFERENT from the round-win group.
ROW4 columns1-4 MATCH LOSS: four different disappointed/crouched/recovering postures, unharmed. Columns5-8 SUPER: Waffle stays visibly inside his complete Police Robo: ready, aim the actual bubble nozzle, release ONE small blue transparent capture bubble close to the nozzle in THIRD pose, recover. Bubble is a NONLETHAL capture tool, never a damaging ray. No kitten or captured victim is drawn. Four NEW drawings, different from row3.
ROW5 columns1-4 IDLE: four different breathing/weight/wing/ear poses. Columns5-8 RUN: four actual alternating locomotion strides; flying or serpentine movement uses the real anatomy.
ROW6 columns1-4 ORDINARY ACTION: Four distinct postures for the named ordinary source action: Bulle d’arrestation du Police Robo. Prepare, aim or wind up, real source action in THIRD pose, recover. Keep the exact fixed anatomy and tool. No unrelated power or missing equipment. Columns5-8 HIT REACTION: four gentle flinch/steady/recover postures, complete and unharmed.

All48 are genuinely DIFFERENT DRAWINGS, never copied, shifted, mirrored, recoloured or padded duplicates. No attack or flash outside attack groups. No victim, blood, wounds, corpse, dismemberment or injury. Friendly solo game animation. These are original adapted drawings, not official game sprite frames.
